note: 断言mouse工具观察按钮、双击间隔和报告频率。目标原文"whether every physical button actually sends a signal"、"how fast your two clicks land compared to the operating system's double-click window"、"roughly how often the mouse reports its position (report rate, commonly called polling rate)"；这是浏览器estimate（coalesced caveat），桥接只说观察，没有声称硬件精密真值。
